answer: A bond is refunded only after 42 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The violet counter is kept in ocean and ferrous reveals each reset. An copycat therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 42 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2239 identities would post 1920 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
